output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-eea385744194] is just a metric name. But it sits in the 3.0.0 'Metrics namespace' list, and that section's intro [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to every metric in the list. Metrics that started with `cortex_` will now start with `loki_`, because the `metrics_namespace` default is `loki`. Operators can keep the old prefix by setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex`, though that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That gives the subject (the metric `cortex_query_scheduler_inflight_requests_sum`), the change (renamed to `loki_query_scheduler_inflight_requests_sum`), who is exposed (deployments that don't set `metrics_namespace: cortex`) and the consequence (the metric is no longer published under its old `cortex_` name).
